job.question: Which pension system's investment consultant RFP requires respondents to have at least five defined benefit pension plan clients, two of which are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $15 billion each?
job.expected_facts: Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS), in its 2021 investment consultant services RFP (Appendix E, Minimum Qualifications Certification).
job.acceptance: OCERS/Orange County Employees Retirement System suffices. Appendix designation, year and restatement of qualification are optional.

prior_reviews.reason: The document identifies OCERS and a similar client-count requirement, but it is a 2022 custody-services RFP, not the investment-consultant RFP. Its asset threshold is $25 billion per public plan, not $15 billion.
quotes: Custody Services Request for Proposal October 2022 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
The Orange County Employees Retirement System (“OCERS”) is requesting proposals from qualified firms with expertise in providing a comprehensive set of custody services.
Respondent must have at least five (5) defined benefit pension plan clients, of which two (2) are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $25 billion each.
